description:
Resolve the remaining fz2 source-surface failures from the fz-rh2.9 sweep after compiler2 has finished the upstream definition-macro cutover in `fz-rh2.16.11`: keyword_lists, no_parens_call, no_parens_do, no_parens_keyword, sample_tests, sample_tests_module.

This ticket is no longer allowed to patch around definition/publication structure. By the time it starts, top-level scope-shaping definitions should already enter compiler2 through compiler macros plus `Fz.Compiler.define(..., __ENV__)`, with raw function facts staying lazy behind demand. What remains here are front-door/source-surface contract gaps above that seam: unsupported keyword/no-parens surface forms, item-level test macro handling once the definition model is unified, and test module main/root policy.

Signal: each remaining surface is either supported through normal source expansion and fixture-matrix fz2 paths on top of the unified definition model, or explicitly declared outside the compiler2 cutover contract.

comments.text: Folded at 5cab6c605 (clean auto-merge with struct-slice/16.2 on world.rs+fixture_matrix.rs). Fixed correct-by-construction (option a): generalized the prelude mechanism (World::extra_preludes + register_scoped_prelude, mirroring runtime_prelude) so the test macro is its OWN CodeId (test:prelude.fz) scoped into the test root's world via the existing fact->producer pull; user source submitted verbatim with true offsets. Non-vacuous span test (asserts offset 21 not 195). Dispositions verified live: no_parens_* already green (corpus 16.4.1); keyword_lists was a FIXTURE bug (asserted merged arity-1; real Elixir appends arity+1 -> fixed fixture + append-never-merge regression test, confirmed vs ../elixir); sample_tests/sample_tests_module -> new fz2 test [--interp] CLI (real-parser discovery, subprocess-per-test, assert->abort), build deferred structural. Audit also confirmed discovery robust + subprocess attribution correct; discovery-shape guard added. Composed-branch matrix 350/11 (keyword_lists green all paths; sample_tests* run/interp green, build deferred), lib 1253/0/6, clippy+fmt clean. Follow-ups: fz-rh2.16.4.2 (no-parens do-merge divergence).
